items.title: LATAM Unveils New Airbus A321XLR Business Class Suites, Coming March 2027
items.why: Narrow-body suites widen premium cabin options for Latin American airline partnership and travel benefit conversations.
items.summary_ai: LATAM revealed cabins for its A321XLR jets, including 12 business suites with direct aisle access, arriving March 2027.
items.take: Narrow-body suites widen premium cabin options for Latin American airline partnership and travel benefit conversations.
